channel.title: Storage Wars
channel.desc: The gang's all here and then some! The bidders have brought their family members along to the auction to show them the ropes or maybe just for some familial rivalry; team Calvin gets their first ever locker, the Brothers Crossley find some chimes during their quality time, and Gunter tells Rene to gamble on an ATV that hasn't run in years... maybe father really does know best?
